children: Next week's monthly WASDE report from the USDA may show higher yields for U.S. soybeans, says StoneX in its latest crop estimates. The firm says that it projects soybean yields at 54.1 bushels an acre, with production at 4.65 billion bushels. Both of these estimates would be above last month's USDA projections, and record-highs for U.S. soybeans. StoneX also adjusted its corn yield forecast to 182.1 bpa, down from the firm's previous forecast of 182.9 bpa but well above the 178.5 bpa the USDA projected last month. StoneX projects corn production at 16.12 billion bushels, which would be the second-largest crop in U.S. history. CBOT corn falls 0.5%, soybeans drop 0.2%, and wheat is up 0.4%. (kirk.maltais@wsj.com)
